summary: Describes a way to write down and store IP routing policies in a routing registry, such as the RIPE database. It updates the earlier ripe-81 proposal, adds extensions suggested by Merit, and aims to be a common representation for all Internet routing registries. It serves as both tutorial and detailed reference.

eli5.summary: Networks have rules about whose traffic they will carry. This memo is a shared notebook format so everyone can write those rules down the same way and others can read them.

questions: how are routing policies stored in a routing registry
